title: The cell’s folded membranes
hook: Inspect the cell and find the structure behind its function.

knows: Atoms or cells can be represented with simplified models.
doesNotKnow: Mitochondria have an inner membrane folded into cristae. The inner membrane is the site of ATP synthesis during oxidative phosphorylation.

misconception: A familiar diagram automatically reveals the structure or function.
objective: Mitochondria have an inner membrane folded into cristae. The inner membrane is the site of ATP synthesis during oxidative phosphorylation.

recall.question: Which organelle has a folded inner membrane where much ATP is made during cellular respiration?
recall.why: Mitochondria have an inner membrane folded into cristae. The inner membrane is the site of ATP synthesis during oxidative phosphorylation.
